messages:
Nikhil Rao: Heads-up: LumenPay interview notes are in the drive. Want to finalize quotes and the webinar hook today. Target publish + webinar invite next Thursday.
Elena Park: I edited the transcript and pulled three punchy lines we could use in the hero / promo. Dropping them here.
Elena Park: ```
1) "Redwood made our latency predictable at scale."
2) "We reduced generate cost while keeping quality — big win for our margins."
3) "The rollout tools let us ship the weekly model update without customer impact."
```
Samir Gupta: Customer prefers #2 as the lead quote, wants the word "cost" phrased as "inference spend". They asked we include the 32% savings number from their internal report.
Priya Menon: Legal: comparative/percent claims need attestation. If LumenPay signs the attestation or we link the ROI appendix, we can keep 32% verbatim. Also request they approve the final quote text and logo usage.
Nikhil Rao: Can we prepare two variants of the hero: one with the 32% and one saying "over 30%"? We can use the softened version for social if legal needs extra time.
Elena Park: Working on social copy + 15s webinar promo script. Draft hero (hard): 
"LumenPay cut inference spend by 32% with Redwood, preserving generation quality and enabling weekly model updates."
Elena Park: Draft hero (soft): 
"LumenPay reduced inference spend by over 30% with Redwood while preserving generation quality."
Assets Bot: Uploaded hero images and 1-slide summary to #marketing-assets: https://drive.redwood/lumenpay/assets (preview available).
Samir Gupta: Sent signed attestation email from LumenPay with the 32% figure and logo usage consent. Forwarding now.
Priya Menon: Received attestation. Quick redline: change "cut" to "reduced" in headline for tone, and add "per LumenPay" after the figure for attribution. Also attach the ROI appendix link.
Nikhil Rao: OK — final choices: use the hard hero on case study page with attribution, use soft hero for Twitter/X and Linkedin posts. Webinar promo will call out a live panel with LumenPay and our PMM.
Elena Park: Can the design team get approval on the slide deck copy? If legal ok, I'll push final images by EOD.
Priya Menon: Legal greenlight pending the logo usage clause; I sent one small tweak to the customer. If they sign by noon, we can publish the landing + schedule the webinar invite for Thursday.
Samir Gupta: Customer approved the tweak. They also provided a short recorded clip we can use in the webinar promo.
Nikhil Rao: Great — assign owners: Elena finalizes imagery and social snippets; Samir confirms that the SDRs get the 1-slide summary and the playbook for inbound leads; Priya will add final legal stamp and publish the signed release.
Elena Park: Dropping final assets in #marketing-assets in 45m.
Assets Bot: Files uploaded: hero_v3.png, webinar_15s_v2.mp4, sdrcase_onepager.pdf.
Nikhil Rao: Thanks team. Once live, we'll route webinar signups through the standard SDR queue and tag LumenPay leads for CS follow-up. Closing thread unless issues come up. :party_popper:
